author: blu
body: Proves Tranquility. "Destroy all enchantments." compiles to DestroyAllEnchantments; applying it sweeps every enchantment (global enchantments and auras, both players') and leaves creatures, artifacts, and lands alone. The AI scores it on the enchantment differential, so it fires only when the opponent controls more enchantments than the caster (else it would blow up the caster's own anthem, so it is held below the -1000 floor).
